review.notes: All 21 physical pages' extracted text was swept with 5-gram shingle comparison against the OCR markdown (normalized: math spanned to placeholders, hyphenated line breaks joined). No code fences exist; the heading tree (1-5, subsections 2.1-2.2, 3.1-3.5, Contributions & Acknowledgements, References) is complete; the print has no tables and the OCR has none to lose. All figure captions (Figures 1-15, including Figure 9's bin-picking success-rate caption) are present; results numbers in prose (e.g. 33.3% to 79.0%, 38 million videos, over 100 tasks/objects) match the print. Reference entries [1]-[71] match the print including Turkish diacritics in ref [33] (OCR 'Yağmurlu' matches the rendered print; the PDF text layer's 'Ya˘gmurlu' is an extraction artifact). Contributions bullets and the acknowledgements paragraph are complete across the p.17-p.18 break. Remaining shingle gaps all resolve to figure-internal content shown by the 29 embedded figures: video-text training-sample caption strips inside Figure 1, GT/Pred frame labels of Figures 11-15, chart contents of Figures 9-10, and scaling-chart curves; the OCR even preserves the print's own typo 'undegoes' in the Figure 1 caption.
